description: READ ONLY. Answers "does this notice have to go by Certified Mail or with a return receipt, by when, and to whom?" BEFORE any letter exists, from Piloxa’s curated table of U.S. statutes and regulations, each with its citation and official link. Use it when the person asks things like "do I have to send this certified?", "how long does my landlord have to return my deposit?", "how do I dispute a debt with a collector?", "is there a deadline to dispute this credit card charge?" or "what notice do I need before suing a business?". Covers federal rules (debt validation and cease contact, credit report disputes, credit card billing errors, loan rescission, door-to-door sales) and some state rules (deposits, repair notices, month-to-month termination, consumer demand letters in CA, TX, FL and MA). When the table has no rule it says "unknown" (coverage not_covered); never present that as "not required". It is general information with sources, not legal advice; say so. It creates, stores, mails and charges nothing. When the person wants to send the notice, draft it with what_to_include and call prepare_certified_letter.

notice_type.description: Optional. The kind of notice, if clear; otherwise it is read from the situation.

situation.description: The person’s situation in their words, e.g. "I moved out of my Texas apartment 5 weeks ago and the landlord kept my deposit". Up to 2,000 characters; leave out account numbers and other private details.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code where the rule would apply (usually where the property is or where the person lives). Left out, it is read from the situation if named.

name: check_notice_requirement

certified_mail_required.description: required, required_for_one_party (see each rule), permitted, alternative_to_step, not_required, not_required_federally_state_unknown, or unknown.

coverage.description: not_covered means the requirement is unknown, not that there is none.

rules.description: Each rule: title, jurisdiction, applies_to, certified_mail, return_receipt, deadline, address_to, what_to_include, source { citation, url, last_reviewed }.

title: Check if a notice must go by Certified Mail
